summary: Re-tested the auth/security fixes and desktop/mobile marketplace flows. Authenticated payment, transaction action, and upload work; anonymous access is rejected; OTP is email-bound; all requested UI journeys and visible toast feedback passed.

minor.issue: The allowlist is hardcoded in server.py instead of using the existing CORS_ORIGINS environment variable; current live responses correctly omit allow-credentials and do not create wildcard credential CORS.

integration_issues.issue: POST succeeds and shows the toast, but Requests keeps the pre-submit in-memory list until a full reload/navigation data fetch; the newly created row is not immediately rendered.

action_items: Use CORS_ORIGINS from environment configuration rather than a hardcoded origin.
Refresh or append request state after successful request creation so the new request appears immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: Module-level REQUESTS and TRANSACTIONS remain process-local and non-persistent; acceptable for this explicitly mocked demo but unsuitable for multi-worker production use.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ requests and mocked transactions during regression/UI testing; state is process-local.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security regression and core desktop/mobile flows are covered. Retest request list refresh and environment-driven CORS after fixes. OTP, auth/me, anonymous sensitive endpoints, valid authenticated payment/upload/transaction action, hire, rental, drone empty search, profile, insights, navigation, and loop-toast feedback passed.
rca of the issue: The requested auth fixes are present: require_session validates Bearer tokens, OTP_CHALLENGES is keyed by normalized email, and App stores the returned token in axios defaults. The remaining request UI issue is caused by Requests receiving a snapshot of data from App and never updating it after POST; CORS configuration is explicit but bypasses the configured environment key.
